name: simpleworkoutgen
description: SimpleWorkoutGen — home workout builder, web + iOS native shell via Capacitor

scripts.build:web: rm -rf www && mkdir -p www && cp index.html www/ && cp -r js www/ && cp -r css www/ && cp -r img www/ && [ -d audio ] && cp -r audio www/ || true
scripts.sync:ios: npm run build && npx cap sync ios

author: Joe Hassell
